# Klarna

18 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 8 standard (1 credit), 8 advanced (5), 2 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

Klarna's shopping comparison graph - the widest merchant-offer surface here. One product id resolves to every merchant selling it, its price history, both user and professional reviews, and a side-by-side comparison against another product. Category endpoints go beyond a taxonomy: filters, popular search keywords, and buying-guide copy. Product/Review/Seller rows use the canonical schemas, so they line up with Amazon, Walmart, Target, eBay, and Home Depot.

## GET /v1/klarna/categories - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Klarna's browse taxonomy for a region: each node's id, display name, and children. Feed a node id into GET /v1/klarna/category to walk products, or GET /v1/klarna/categories/children for the next level.

**Use when** Use it as the entry point for category browsing. Feed a node id into category or categories/children.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - The upstream returns the complete root taxonomy in one call (the USA tree was 398KB on 2026-09-02) and exposes no page parameter.

**Query params**

- `region` (optional, enum: usa | uk | germany | sweden | france | italy | spain | netherlands | austria | ireland | norway | finland | denmark) - Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data`, `{ categories }` (inferred from a sample): `categories`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/categories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/klarna/categories/children - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Klarna category and its children. t1 (TV and Audio) returned Headphones as cl94. Unknown category ids return 404 and are not billed.

**Use when** you have a category id and need the next level before walking products.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - One category node plus its child list in a single call; no page parameter.

**Query params**

- `category_id` (required) - Klarna category id, for example cl94 for Headphones or t1 for TV and Audio. Ids come from GET /v1/klarna/categories and from search rows as category.id. Required for GET /v1/klarna/product when you pass product_id instead of a shopping URL. · e.g. `t1`
- `region` (optional, enum: usa | uk | germany | sweden | france | italy | spain | netherlands | austria | ireland | norway | finland | denmark) - Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): `categories`, `id`, `image.description`, `image.path`, `name`, `path`, `shortName`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/categories/children" \
  --data-urlencode "category_id=t1" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/klarna/category - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns products in a Klarna category, 48 per page by default, each with product id, title, lowest price, rating, and image. Pagination is clean: page 2 of Headphones had 24 new ids and zero overlap with page 1. Feed a category id from GET /v1/klarna/categories.

**Use when** you want to walk a category. Category ids come from GET /v1/klarna/categories.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** offset (native `offset`) · 48/page · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/48) x 5 credits

**Query params**

- `category_id` (required) - Klarna category id, for example cl94 for Headphones or t1 for TV and Audio. Ids come from GET /v1/klarna/categories and from search rows as category.id. Required for GET /v1/klarna/product when you pass product_id instead of a shopping URL. · e.g. `cl94`
- `region` (optional, enum: usa | uk | germany | sweden | france | italy | spain | netherlands | austria | ireland | norway | finland | denmark) - Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.
- `size` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Products per page, 1 to 100. Default 48.
- `offset` (optional, integer, min 0) - Row offset, starting at 0. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: popularity | price_low | price_high | trend | name | rating | price_drop) - Result ordering: popularity (default), price_low, price_high, trend, name, rating, or price_drop.
- `price_range` (optional, string) - Price filter as min-max, for example 50-500, or 50- for 50 and above.
- `filter` (optional, string) - Facet filter as keyID-valueID from GET /v1/klarna/category/filters.
- `category_path_id` (optional, string) - Sub-category path id as keyID-valueID.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.description` |  |

+5 more fields in the full schema. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

## GET /v1/klarna/product - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one Klarna shopping product: title, description, brand, rating, review count, and specifications. This payload has no list price; call GET /v1/klarna/product/offers for merchant prices. Pass the numeric product id plus category_id (cl94), or pass the full shopping URL and both ids are extracted. Ghost ids return 404 and are not billed.

**Use when** you already have a product id (3331931731) plus a category id, or a klarna.com shopping URL. For discovery, start at search or category.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - Klarna product id, the numeric id in a shopping URL: klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/... is product id 3331931731. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/klarna/search and GET /v1/klarna/category. · e.g. `3331931731`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Klarna shopping URL, for example https://www.klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/Headphones/Apple-AirPods-4-with-Active-Noise-Cancellation-White/. The product id and category id are extracted from the path.
- `category_id` (optional, string) - Klarna category id, for example cl94 for Headphones or t1 for TV and Audio. Ids come from GET /v1/klarna/categories and from search rows as category.id. Required for GET /v1/klarna/product when you pass product_id instead of a shopping URL. · e.g. `cl94`
- `region` (optional, enum: usa | uk | germany | sweden | france | italy | spain | netherlands | austria | ireland | norway | finland | denmark) - Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |

| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.description` |  |
| `product.reviews_count` |  |

+2 more fields in the full schema.

## GET /v1/klarna/product/price-history - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns historical merchant prices for a product: lowest, highest, currency, per-merchant time series, and the merchant directory. interval is ONE_MONTH, THREE_MONTHS (default), or INFINITE_DAYS.

**Use when** you want to chart price movement. Current offers are on GET /v1/klarna/product/offers.
**Cost** cache 1800 s
**Paging** single page - The upstream returns the full history for the chosen interval in one call (93 points over three months, 723 over INFINITE_DAYS on AirPods 4) and exposes no page parameter.

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - Klarna product id, the numeric id in a shopping URL: klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/... is product id 3331931731. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/klarna/search and GET /v1/klarna/category. · e.g. `3331931731`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Klarna shopping URL, for example https://www.klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/Headphones/Apple-AirPods-4-with-Active-Noise-Cancellation-White/. The product id and category id are extracted from the path.
- `region` (optional, enum: usa | uk | germany | sweden | france | italy | spain | netherlands | austria | ireland | norway | finland | denmark) - Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.
- `interval` (optional, enum: ONE_MONTH | THREE_MONTHS | INFINITE_DAYS) - History window: ONE_MONTH, THREE_MONTHS (default), or INFINITE_DAYS.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `product_id`, `url`.

**Response** `Analytics` object at `data` (inferred from a sample): `currencyCode`, `highest`, `history`, `lowest`, `merchants`, `productId`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/product/price-history" \
  --data-urlencode "product_id=3331931731" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/klarna/reviews - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns written user reviews aggregated across merchants, 10 per page by default, each with text, star rating, title, reviewer name, source domain, and date. Pagination is clean: page 2 of AirPods 4 had 0 overlapping extracts with page 1. Pass the returned cursor back until has_more is false.

**Use when** you have a product id and need the review text. The star average is already on GET /v1/klarna/product.
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.
**Paging** cursor (native `nextBatchId`) · default page size not measured; set with `limit` · depth unknown

**Query params**

- `product_id` (optional, string) - Klarna product id, the numeric id in a shopping URL: klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/... is product id 3331931731. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/klarna/search and GET /v1/klarna/category. · e.g. `3331931731`
- `url` (optional, string) - Full Klarna shopping URL, for example https://www.klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/Headphones/Apple-AirPods-4-with-Active-Noise-Cancellation-White/. The product id and category id are extracted from the path.

## GET /v1/klarna/reviews/pro - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns professional and expert reviews for a Klarna product, 10 per page, each with text, score, source, and date. AirPods 4 had 21 professional reviews; page 2 returned 8 rows and terminated.

**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.

## GET /v1/klarna/stores - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Klarna's retailer directory, 24 per page, each with store UUID, display name, Klarna store URL, icons, and checkout flags. Pagination is clean: page 2 had 24 new ids and zero overlap with page 1. USA totalHits was 10000 on 2026-09-02. Optional filters: categories (fashion, travel), cashback, shop_in_app, klarna_at_checkout.
